title.en: Launch 21-day learning paths, score rewards, and five-category rankings
title.zh: 发布 21 天学习路径、成绩奖励与五类排行榜

purpose.en: Turn Today’s Sprint, SmartCard Practice, SmartCard Challenge, and subscribed courses into coherent day-based learning journeys with server-owned progress, configurable rewards, and transparent score history.
purpose.zh: 将今日速成、智慧卡练习、智慧卡挑战与已订阅课程统一为按天推进的学习旅程，并提供服务器持久进度、可配置奖励及透明成绩记录。

en: Add a 21-day easiest-to-capstone progression and Day 1/previous/next/Day 21 navigation to Today’s Sprint, SmartCard Practice, and the core course-learning journey.
Give signed-in learners automatic next-unfinished-day continuation while preserving explicit day skipping; anonymous Sprint and SmartCard state remains feature-local and cookie-bound.

Publish Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced SmartCard entry points; each language-level challenge draws one persisted shared set of 20 daily questions from a difficulty-ascending, frequency-descending 500-item pool, keyed only by the learner’s local YYYY-MM-DD date.
Add permanent-admin batch editing for 36 score-reward rules covering four learning features, three levels, and three score bands.
Add the signed-in score-history dashboard and five ranking categories with language selection and server-derived top-25 lists.

Keep Everyday Speaking scene tiles Beginner-first with separate Intermediate and Advanced actions, real-person paired dialogue, ten motion assets per scene, optional user-language audio help, and repeat-after-me off by default.
Use an accessible generic concept illustration whenever a word has no dedicated visual, and make slow speech materially slower across Sprint, SmartCard, courses, and Everyday Speaking.
Fix feedback-action button contrast so Continue controls remain readable on correct and incorrect result panels.
zh: 为今日速成、智慧卡练习和核心课程学习加入从易到难的 21 天路径，以及第 1 天、前一天、后一天和第 21 天导航。
登录学习者自动继续下一个未完成学习日，同时可手动跳日；匿名今日速成与智慧卡状态继续按功能隔离并仅绑定 Cookie。
发布初、中、高三级智慧卡入口；每个语言等级的挑战从按难度升序、常用度降序排列的 500 题池中，按学习者本地 YYYY-MM-DD 日期持久生成当天全体用户共用的 20 题。
为永久管理员新增 36 条成绩奖励规则的批量编辑，覆盖四类学习功能、三级难度和三个成绩档位。
新增登录用户成绩记录页，以及带语言选择和服务器前 25 名的五类排行榜。
生活口语场景卡默认进入初级，并单列中级、高级；保留真人一问一答、每场景十个动态媒体、用户语言语音辅助及默认关闭跟读评分。
无专用词图时显示可访问的通用概念插画，并让今日速成、智慧卡、课程和生活口语的慢速播放真正明显变慢。
修复反馈操作区按钮对比度，使正确与错误结果页的继续按钮都清晰可读。

en: Today’s Sprint picker/player/API, SmartCard directory/practice/challenge/calendar/API, subscribed course workspace/API, Everyday Speaking levels and audio, member Dashboard, Admin Dashboard, SiteHeader, score history, rankings, vocabulary visuals, D1 schema, and release contracts.
zh: 今日速成选择器、播放器与接口；智慧卡目录、练习、挑战、日历与接口；已订阅课程工作台与接口；生活口语等级和语音；用户面板、管理面板、全站导航、成绩记录、排行榜、词汇视觉、D1 架构及发布合同。

en: Add tracked migration 0167 with additive day-state tables, reward rules, unified learning-score history, daily SmartCard question sets, and 24 new official Intermediate/Advanced deck identities.

Select learning words with the existing pedagogical order of difficulty ascending then frequency descending; allocate 20 words per selected day and keep cumulative adaptive sentences constrained to current and prior learned vocabulary.
Separate motivational learning rewards from legacy course-credit commerce and protect admin changes with permanent bootstrap-administrator authorization.
Record only server-computed signed-in completions in score history; no anonymous session, audio, or transcript is persisted by these changes.

Use each challenger’s local calendar day from 00:00:00 through 23:59:59, generate a date-only question set only for that local today, and delay winner settlement until the latest global time zone has finished the date.
Preserve the selected Beginner, Intermediate, or Advanced challenge level when the learner returns from a timed challenge to its calendar.
Preserve the established 7- and 14-day introductory course products; the 21-day selector applies to the core 30-day and higher-level course journeys without changing course prices or entitlements.
zh: 新增受跟踪迁移 0167：增量学习日状态表、奖励规则、统一学习成绩历史、智慧卡每日题集，以及 24 个新的正式中级/高级卡组标识。
按既有教学顺序选择单词：难度升序、常用度降序；每个所选学习日分配 20 个词，累积自适应句子只使用当前及此前已学词汇。
将学习激励分与旧有课程抵扣积分商业账本严格分离，管理员修改仅允许永久初始管理员执行。
成绩历史只记录服务器计算的登录用户完成结果；本次变化不会持久化匿名会话、录音或语音转写。
智慧卡挑战按每位用户本地日期的 00:00:00 至 23:59:59 开放，只为本地今天生成纯日期题集，并等全球最晚时区结束该日期后再结算冠军。
学习者从限时挑战返回日历时，保留所选的初级、中级或高级挑战等级。
保留既有 7 天和 14 天入门课程产品；21 天选择器应用于核心 30 天及更高等级课程旅程，不改变课程价格或权益。

en: Production-equivalent vinext build passed, including sensitive-data scan and Cloudflare Worker artifact validation.
TypeScript passed with no errors; all 63 tracked D1 migrations apply from a fresh database, no-op on rerun, and pass foreign-key and integrity checks.
The complete automated suite passes 356 tests, including new 21-day, reward, ranking, timezone, visual fallback, and slow-speech contracts.
Media audit confirms 12,000 Beginner lexemes, 11,434/11,434 imageable lexemes covered, 6,044 reusable media concepts, 120 conversation GIFs, and 12 scene images.
zh: 等同生产的 vinext 构建通过，包括敏感数据扫描与 Cloudflare Worker 产物验证。
TypeScript 零错误；全部 63 个受跟踪 D1 迁移可在全新数据库执行、重复执行无变化，并通过外键与完整性检查。
完整自动化套件共 356 项全部通过，新增覆盖 21 天路径、奖励、排行榜、时区、视觉兜底与慢速语音合同。
媒体审计确认：12,000 个初级词条、11,434/11,434 个可图示词条全部覆盖、6,044 个可复用媒体概念、120 个对话 GIF 和 12 张场景图。

en: Real human microphone scoring cannot be fully automated; browser acceptance verifies the controls and safe fallback, while a human learner should perform the final acoustic-quality check.
Unified score history begins with completions after this additive migration; legacy scores remain in their original auditable tables and are not rewritten or backfilled.
zh: 真实人声麦克风评分无法完全自动化；浏览器验收会核对控件和安全兜底，最终声学质量仍需真人学习者确认。
统一成绩历史从本次增量迁移后的完成记录开始；旧成绩继续保存在原有可审计数据表中，不改写、不回填。

en: Preserve SmartLingo’s 12 interface languages, 12 learning languages, Clerk identity, D1 ownership, Cloudflare deployment, AI gateway, original media assets, course pricing, college revenue split, and all payment/referral boundaries.
No other portfolio site, external account, credential, payment rail, college subscription, or cloud resource is modified.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 的 12 种界面语言、12 种学习语言、Clerk 身份、D1 数据归属、Cloudflare 发布、AI 网关、原创媒体、课程定价、学院分成及全部支付/推荐边界。
不修改任何其他站点、外部账户、凭据、支付通道、学院订阅或云资源。
